## Geographic & Local Presence (Karachi, Pakistan)

## Key Technical Competencies
### 1. Backend Engineering & Distributed Web Services
- Frameworks: ASP.NET Core (.NET 8), .NET Core MVC, Web API.
- Language: C# (C-Sharp) with modern language features (pattern matching, records, primary constructors, async/await).
- Architectural Patterns: Clean Architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Presentation layers), CQRS with MediatR, Repository and Unit of Work patterns, Dependency Injection.
- Reliability & Safety: Idempotency keys (`X-Idempotency-Key` via UUIDs) to prevent double-billing and duplicate state changes; background workers utilizing `PeriodicTimer` for deterministic auto-expiration routines.

### 2. Relational Database Engineering & Concurrency Control
- Databases: Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL), PostgreSQL 15, Supabase (with Row Level Security policies).
- Concurrency Control:
  - Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) using `RowVersion` timestamp columns in EF Core, throwing `DbUpdateConcurrencyException` upon conflicting writes.
  - Pessimistic row-locking in PostgreSQL (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) to eliminate concurrent counter increments and sequence duplication in financial transactions.
- Query Performance: Covering non-clustered indexes (`CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX ... INCLUDE (...)`) to avoid expensive table key lookups for high-frequency queries.

### 3. Mobile & Cross-Platform Development
- Framework: Flutter 3.27+ with Dart 3.6+.
- State Management: Riverpod 3.x (AsyncNotifier, StateNotifier).
- Platform Targets: Android, iOS, Windows desktop, and Web.
- Realtime & Backend Integration: Supabase Postgres CDC (Change Data Capture) via WebSockets.

### 4. Frontend & User Interface Engineering
- Frameworks: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Vite.
- Design Principles: High visual hierarchy, accessibility (ARIA, WCAG 2.1 AA), responsive mobile-first layouts, micro-interactions, dark mode aesthetic.

### 5. Security & Authentication
- Standards: OAuth 2.0 multi-provider integration (Google, GitHub, Discord).
- Identity: ASP.NET Core Identity with password hashing, email verification, and role-based authorization (RBAC).
- Two-Factor Authentication: Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) algorithm using RFC 6238 and QR code provisioning via OtpNet.

## Project Case Studies & Engineering Evidence
### Shifa Management System (SMS)
- URL: https://ahmedhusssain.vercel.app/work/shifamanagement
- Repository: https://github.com/ahmed-husssain/ShifaMangementSystem
- Client: Shifa Home Health Care (Karachi, Pakistan)
- Problem: Manual paper-based patient intake, non-standardized nursing shift records, duplicate invoice creation, and missed 14-day care plan renewal windows.
- Engineering Solution: Built a cross-platform Flutter ERP backed by Supabase PostgreSQL. Enforced row-level locking during invoice number generation to guarantee zero duplicate financial sequences. Implemented automatic WhatsApp billing summary delivery and 14-day automated renewal warnings for doctors and clinical supervisors.

### Gallrax ERP / Online Art Gallery
- URL: https://ahmedhusssain.vercel.app/work/online-art-gallery
- Repository: https://github.com/ahmed-husssain/Online-Art-Gallery-Website
- Problem: Real-time auction bids clashing concurrently, causing lost bids and stale price updates.
- Engineering Solution: Designed an ASP.NET Core 8 backend paired with SignalR WebSockets for sub-50ms live room broadcasts. Protected auction product updates with EF Core Optimistic Concurrency (`RowVersion`). Designed a background worker with `PeriodicTimer` that settles and closes expired auctions automatically without human intervention.

### Mockrithm
- URL: https://ahmedhusssain.vercel.app/work/mockrithm
- Distinction: Runner-Up at Aptech Vision 2025 competition.
- Purpose: Interactive algorithmic visualization tool helping students and developers prepare for coding interviews by stepping through complex sorting, searching, and graph traversals frame-by-frame.
